program.name: Bodyweight Long Haul
program.subject: Bodyweight
program.blurb: Longer bodyweight days in straight sets: push, legs, then pull and core.
program.about: No equipment and enough time to do it properly. Three days rotate in straight sets: push-ups and dips, then squats, lunges and glute work, then floor pulls and core. Each has five moves, so every muscle gets its volume without a single weight. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows the lowering to three seconds.
program.split: Push / legs / pull & core, no gear
